messages:
lara_fin: Heads up — nightly billing check showed 12 customer balances off after refund window. NetSuite missing corresponding credit memos for Stripe refunds. Anyone on refund worker?

 tom_eng: noticed worker restarts around 01:40 UTC. logs show refund-processor hitting a queue-trim threshold. when the worker restarted the in-memory retry queue lost some entries.

 nina_ops: confirmed: supervisor killed refund-processor after memory spike; supervisor restarted it but the in-memory retry state was not persisted. build-bot posted crash loop alerts.

 alex_fs: immediate impact: 12 refunds (~$2,150) not applied in NetSuite. Collections contacted 3 customers. Finance requests CSV of missing refund ids + approval to issue manual credits while we backfill.

 tom_eng: short-term mitigation: enabled durable retry persistence (feature-flag) and lowered in-memory cap. also added a startup scan to pick up unacked webhooks from the durable queue. deploy in progress.

 lara_fin: please dump CSV to /shared/finance/refund-issues/2267123456-missing.csv and include amount, stripe_refund_id, stripe_charge_id, customer_email, and note field to say "manual-credit-pending-backfill". seeking ops approval for up to $2.5k in manual credits.

 nina_ops: approved. include audit note and tag finance-ops. :white_check_mark:

 tom_eng: deploy finished. recovery found 14 candidates; 12 matched missing refunds and 2 look like duplicates. starting dry-run backfill and will produce staging table for finance to review prior to apply. sample webhook shape used for dedupe check:

 ```json
 {
   "id": "evt_rfExample",
   "type": "charge.refunded",
   "data": {
     "object": {
       "id": "re_1Example",
       "amount": 180,
       "refunds": { "data": [ { "id": "rf_1Example" } ] },
       "customer": "cus_ABC123"
     }
   },
   "created": 1705000000
 }
 ```

 lara_fin: thanks. I'll review the dry-run output once uploaded. Collections hold placed for affected accounts. keep thread updates short.
